entities.summary: Stalin's victory over Trotsky, the Five-Year Plans and forced industrialisation, collectivisation and the Ukrainian Holodomor (1932–33), the Great Terror (1936–38), show trials, the Gulag system (18 million prisoners), and the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact (1939).
